description: Thermo-Mechanically Treated reinforcement steel bars, stirrups, and corrosion resistant steel under IS 1786:2008.
Ordinary Portland Cement (33, 43, 53), PPC Fly-ash based, Portland Slag Cement, and Composite Cements.
ISMB Joists, ISMC Channels, Angles, and Structural Plates conforming to IS 2062:2011.
Mild Steel and Galvanized Iron tubes and structural hollow sections conforming to IS 1239:2004 and IS 1161:2014.
Potable hot and cold water distribution pipes, SDR 11/13.5 CPVC (IS 15778) and UPVC (IS 4985).
Standard and design mix concrete (M15 to M50) supplied by transit mixers under IS 4926:2003.
Integral waterproofing admixtures (IS 2645), concrete superplasticizers (IS 9103), and polymeric repair mortars.
Autoclaved Aerated Cellular Concrete blocks conforming to IS 2185 (Part 3):1984.
Burnt clay bricks (IS 1077), fly ash lime bricks (IS 12894), and solid/hollow concrete blocks (IS 2185 Part 1).
Graded granite coarse aggregates (10mm, 20mm, 40mm) and Manufactured Sand (M-Sand Zone II) under IS 383:2016.
Double charged and glazed vitrified tiles (GVT/PGVT) and ceramic tiles conforming to IS 15622:2017.
Color-coated Galvalume (PPGL) and Galvanized (PPGI) corrugated roofing sheets under IS 15965:2012.
High-strength structural bolts, nuts, and washers (Grade 8.8, 10.9) under IS 1367 and IS 3757.
FRLS copper building wires (IS 694:2010), heavy-duty PVC conduits (IS 9537), and modular distribution boards.
